purchase_price.evidence: Trivo Orongo unit list: Unit 11 estudio piso 1, Precio $43,046, Área 38.5 m², balcony 8.76m². Pre-sale / under construction (developer materials cite 2025 construction; scout notes H2 2026 delivery). Parking sold separately.

monthly_rent.source: https://orongoconstructores.com/edificio-orongo/, FazWaz Manta 1BR median ~$419, Barbasquillo suite comps
monthly_rent.evidence: Developer positions Orongo studios for student/professional LTR near PUCE (passive rental product), not oceanfront STR. FazWaz Manta 1BR median ~$419; Barbasquillo suites 55-70m² rent $550-700. Subject only 38.5m² (smaller, inland urbanization, no pool/gym tower amenities). Size/location-adjusted LTR $350-450. Used $400 (scout $450 trimmed for size and non-coast location). STR market avg $342/mo argues against relying on vacation rents.

hoa_monthly.evidence: No alicuota published. Amenities are modest vs oceanfront towers: private urbanization, 24/7 security, access hall, green areas, TAG access — no pool/gym listed. Likely lower than amenity towers ($30-80/mo plausible) but unverified. Must obtain from developer.

special_assessments.evidence: Pre-sale/incomplete building — no HOA assessment history exists yet. Cannot verify future special assessments.

property_taxes_annual.evidence: Ecuador impuesto predial is 0.025%-0.5% of cadastral value (typically well below market). Comparable Manta condos often pay $100-400/yr. For ~$43,046 market price, estimated $40-129/yr; used $51. Exact bill depends on Manta municipal rate and cadastral assessment.

insurance_annual.evidence: Building structure insurance is typically included in Ecuador alicuota. Owner contents/liability: ~$140-210/yr base; Manta coastal earthquake risk adds 15-20%. For ~$43,046 condo, estimated $200-400/yr supplemental owner policy; used $225.

management_annual.evidence: Ecuador long-term property management typically 8-15% of rent. At $400/mo, 10% = $480/yr. Self-management possible with local presence (would be $0).

utilities_annual.evidence: For long-term Ecuador rentals, electricity/water/internet are typically tenant-paid. For STR, utilities are usually recovered in nightly rates or included in management fee. Owner direct cost assumed $0 under standard lease; if owner-paid budget $600-1,500/yr.

other_expenses_annual.evidence: Low-maintenance studio product per developer. Parking purchased separately (capital, not opex). Misc reserves ~$150/yr estimated.

rental_restrictions.evidence: Developer marketing explicitly targets rental income (student/professional demand near PUCE). Bylaws not published; rental use appears intended but not legally verified.

str_restrictions.evidence: Marketing mentions Airbnb as an option on some reseller pages, but building bylaws unavailable. Inland student-oriented product may face HOA/neighbor pushback on STR even if city regulation is Low. Confirm STR permission with developer. LTR is the underwriting base case.

notes: Orongo Unit 11: pre-sale cluster candidate. Delivery risk (construction ~2025 / H2 2026). HOA unknown. Parking not included. Rent path is student/professional LTR, not oceanfront STR. Sibling units share expense assumptions.
